about: The rules engine (no model, no network) run on examples/documents at build time by scripts/build_site_data.py: one lane per document, one clip per cited section with its verbatim text, and the links the engine found between them. Engine ids are random per run and are not kept.

clips.heading: Delivery
clips.text: The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than March 31, 2026.

clips.heading: Delivery
clips.text: The Vendor shall provide weekly written progress reports to the Customer until Acceptance.

clips.heading: Delivery
clips.text: The Customer shall provide the Vendor with access to its test environment within 10 Business Days of the date of this Agreement.

clips.heading: Fees and Payment
clips.text: The Customer shall pay the Vendor a fixed fee of GBP 120,000 for the Phase 1 System.

clips.heading: Fees and Payment
clips.text: The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days of receipt.

clips.heading: Fees and Payment
clips.text: The Vendor may charge interest on late payments at 4% per year above the Bank of England base rate.

clips.heading: Service Levels
clips.text: The Vendor shall ensure the Phase 1 System is available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance.

clips.heading: Service Levels
clips.text: If availability falls below 99.5% in any month, the Customer is entitled to a service credit of 5% of the monthly support fee.

clips.heading: Security and Data
clips.text: The Vendor shall encrypt all Customer data at rest using AES-256 or stronger.

clips.heading: Security and Data
clips.text: The Vendor shall not transfer Customer data outside the United Kingdom without the Customer's prior written consent.

clips.heading: Security and Data
clips.text: The Vendor shall maintain multi-factor authentication for all administrative access to systems that process Customer data.

clips.heading: Delay
clips.text: If the Vendor fails to deliver the Phase 1 System by the date in clause 2.1, the Vendor shall pay liquidated damages of GBP 1,000 for each day of delay, up to a maximum of GBP 30,000.

clips.heading: Delay
clips.text: Clause 6.1 does not apply where the delay is caused by the Customer's failure to comply with clause 2.3.

clips.heading: Term and Termination
clips.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 90 days' written notice to the other party.

clips.heading: Term and Termination
clips.text: The Customer may terminate this Agreement immediately if the Vendor commits a material breach that is not remedied within 30 days of written notice.

clips.heading: Confidentiality
clips.text: Each party must keep the other party's confidential information secret and must not disclose it to any third party, except as required by law.

clips.heading: Amendments
clips.text: Clause 2.1 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with: "The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than May 15, 2026."

clips.heading: Amendments
clips.text: Clause 3.2 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with: "The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt."

clips.heading: Amendments
clips.text: Clause 5.3 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with: "The Vendor shall notify the Customer of any personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it."

clips.heading: Amendments
clips.text: The following clause is added as clause 5.5: "The Vendor shall complete an independent penetration test of the Phase 1 System before go-live and share the summary report with the Customer."

clips.heading: Fees
clips.text: In consideration of the revised delivery date, the Vendor shall reduce the fixed fee in clause 3.1 to GBP 110,000.

lanes.title: Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement

clips.heading: Findings
clips.text: Data location: All Customer data is hosted in the vendor's Dublin, Ireland data centre.

clips.heading: Findings
clips.text: Incident notification: The Vendor's incident response procedure requires customer notification within 72 hours of confirming a breach.

clips.heading: Findings
clips.text: Administrative access: Multi-factor authentication is enforced for administrative access to production systems. However, two shared break-glass accounts were found without multi-factor authentication.

clips.heading: Findings
clips.text: Availability: Measured availability for May 2026 was 99.1%.
